title: ErrorEnvelope
description: One error envelope for every error (API-20), application/problem+json (RFC 9457) extended with the catalogue code, severity, disposition, remediation owner and trace reference (T6, INV-T-2850, SDS §21 archived; live requirement INV-REQ-815/1162's error path). Every service's openapi.yaml references this file rather than declaring its own copy. severity/disposition/remediationOwner/traceRef are optional at the envelope level — `code` alone is required, since only 'code' identifies a catalogue entry and the other four are looked up from it (CS-13); a producer MAY also inline them so a consumer need not look up the catalogue itself. Kept optional (not required) so the T5 scaffold's per-service Error examples keep validating unchanged.

type.description: The catalogue code's documentation URI, or about:blank.

code.description: The AREA-NNN error-catalogue code (model/architecture/error-codes.yaml 'code'; CS-13 generates the ErrorCode enum from it).

severity.description: The catalogue's severity for this code (model/architecture/error-codes.yaml 'severity'; CS-12's outcome kinds).

disposition.description: How the finding is worked off — e.g. TERMINAL, MANUAL, OVERRIDABLE, AUTO_RETRY, AUTO_RELEASE (model/architecture/error-codes.yaml 'disposition').

remediationOwner.description: Who acts on a MANUAL disposition (model/architecture/error-codes.yaml 'owner'), e.g. Integration, Onboarding, Tax operations.

traceRef.description: The W3C traceparent of the request or operation that raised this error (§21 archived), letting support correlate the error with its trace.
